title: OpenGenAlign: A Preference Dataset and Benchmark for Trustworthy Reward Modeling in Open-Ended, Long-Context Generation
authors_zh: Hanning Zhang, Juntong Song, Juno Zhu, Yuanhao Wu, Tong Zhang, Cheng Niu
paper_type_zh: 长上下文偏好数据、奖励模型与策略优化论文
best_for_zh: 需要评估或训练长问答、数据到文本、摘要奖励模型的研究者。
one_line: A 33K preference dataset and benchmark for reward modeling of long-context open-ended generation.
用多次 o3 判决构造长上下文偏好数据，专门衡量幻觉与完整性等生成质量。
why: It provides an auditable judgment-required feedback surface for post-training reasoning data and evaluation.
inclusion_reason: Track 07 addition: the central contribution creates, calibrates, or audits rubric-, expert-, or LLM-judgment data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reward models that score well on chat, safety, or short instruction benchmarks may not distinguish hallucination, completeness, reliability, and efficiency in open-ended long-context generation. The missing feedback data makes it hard to train or compare reward models for long-context QA, data-to-text, and summarization.

OpenGenAlign constructs preference data and a held-out benchmark for those settings, then tests whether the resulting reward signal improves reward modeling, PPO, and guided generation.

在聊天、安全或短指令基准上高分的奖励模型，未必能区分开放式长上下文生成中的幻觉、完整性、可靠性和效率。长上下文问答、数据到文本与摘要缺少对应的偏好反馈，使研究者难以训练或比较真正适用的奖励模型。

OpenGenAlign 为这些场景构造偏好数据和留出基准，并检验所得奖励信号是否改进奖励建模、PPO 和引导生成。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: OpenGenAlign is a 33K-pair preference dataset and benchmark for long-context QA, data-to-text, and summarization. It defines four quality dimensions—hallucination, comprehensiveness, reliability, and efficiency—and asks o3 to compare responses with greater weight on the first two. Three independent o3 judgments and majority vote form each chosen/rejected label; a 100-pair-per-task human study reports 81% agreement with those labels. The paper links an official GitHub project, but its card had no verified official dataset download at intake. The data object is a prompt, two model outputs, four-dimension evaluation, and a voted preference label.

OpenGenAlign 是面向长上下文问答、数据到文本和摘要的 33K 成对偏好数据与基准。它定义幻觉、完整性、可靠性、效率四个质量维度，让 o3 比较回答时更重视前两项；每对由三个独立 o3 判决多数投票形成 chosen/rejected 标签。每个任务随机抽 100 对的人类研究显示与该标签 81% 一致。论文链接官方 GitHub 项目，但卡片收录时未核验到官方数据下载。单条数据是 prompt、两个模型输出、四维评价和投票偏好标签。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Set dimensions and tasks. The authors choose long-context QA (WebGLM), data-to-text (Yelp), and summarization (XSum), and define hallucination, comprehensiveness, reliability, and efficiency with expert input.
  1. Create response pairs. Multiple LLM outputs are paired for each prompt.
  1. Label and validate. o3 compares each pair holistically on the four dimensions, with higher emphasis on hallucination and completeness. Three independent calls are majority-voted; three journalism-major human annotators majority-vote 100 pairs per task to audit agreement.
  1. Train and evaluate. A Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct Bradley-Terry reward model trains on 33K pairs. PPO uses it for Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.2-3B policies; held-out evaluation uses 1.5K examples and a 9K development set for RL.

Reproduction requires the exact prompts, o3 version and sampling, model-pair policy, majority-vote records, task splits, and PPO configuration. Public dataset revision and license require verification.

1. 设定维度与任务。 作者选用 WebGLM 长上下文问答、Yelp 数据到文本、XSum 摘要，并在专家参与下定义幻觉、完整性、可靠性、效率。
  1. 构造回答对。 每个 prompt 收集多个 LLM 输出并配对。
  1. 标注和验证。 o3 按四维整体比较，更重视幻觉和完整性；三次独立调用多数投票。每任务抽 100 对，由三名新闻专业人类标注员多数投票审计一致性。
  1. 训练与评测。 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型在 33K 对上训练；再以它对 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B 做 PPO。留出评测为 1.5K，RL 开发集为 9K。

复现必须固定提示词、o3 版本与采样、配对策略、投票记录、任务切分和 PPO 配置；公开数据版本及许可仍须核验。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. Long-context-specific preference data improves reward modeling and policy optimization beyond a strong general reward-model baseline.

Controlled evidence. Existing reward models score 72.9–78.1 average on the three OpenGenAlign tasks despite 88.8–94.4 on RewardBench (Table 4). The authors train the same Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct base on 33K pairs; its reward model reaches 85.9% held-out accuracy (Table 5). Under PPO, average o3 win rates against the initial policy are 87.7% versus 71.9% for Llama-3.1-8B, and 81.1% versus 71.6% for Llama-3.2-3B, when comparing the proposed reward model with RM-RB2 (Table 6).

This supports usefulness on these three datasets and judges, but the reward and o3 share data-construction assumptions; it does not prove the same benefit for conversational preferences or arbitrary long-context domains.

主张。 针对长上下文的偏好数据能比强通用奖励模型更好地改进奖励建模和策略优化。

受控证据。 既有奖励模型在三项 OpenGenAlign 任务上的平均为 72.9–78.1，尽管它们在 RewardBench 为 88.8–94.4（表 4）。作者用相同 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct base 在 33K 对上训练，留出奖励模型准确率达 85.9%（表 5）。PPO 后，相对初始策略的平均 o3 胜率中，Llama-3.1-8B 为 87.7% 对 71.9%，Llama-3.2-3B 为 81.1% 对 71.6%，比较的是本文奖励模型与 RM-RB2（表 6）。

这支持三项数据集和所用裁判上的价值，但奖励模型和 o3 共享构造假设；不能证明会同样适用于聊天偏好或任意长上下文领域。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Generic preference collections are designed around chat, safety, or short-form helpfulness, and reward benchmarks can therefore miss long-context failure modes. OpenGenAlign changes the feedback object by fixing four long-generation dimensions and collecting multi-judge preferences across QA, data-to-text, and summarization. Using a Bradley-Terry reward model or PPO is not new; the contribution is a domain-targeted preference and benchmark surface with a human-agreement audit and cross-domain mixture test.
通用偏好集合主要面向聊天、安全或短回答帮助性，奖励基准因此可能漏掉长上下文失效模式。OpenGenAlign 改变反馈对象：固定四个长生成维度，并在问答、数据到文本、摘要中收集多裁判偏好。Bradley-Terry 奖励模型和 PPO 本身不是新方法；新意在于有人工一致性审计和跨领域混合检验的领域定向偏好数据与基准面。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Coverage is limited to QA, data-to-text, and summarization; creative writing and other long-context domains are untested. Evaluate a new domain rather than extrapolating the 81% agreement.
  • Labels depend on o3 and majority vote. Human agreement on sampled pairs is not an error-free ground truth; retain individual votes and audit disagreements.
  • Mixing with other preference datasets is not systematically optimized. Verify data availability, license, domain balance, and chat-performance trade-offs before production use.

• 作者只覆盖问答、数据到文本和摘要，未包含创作等其他长上下文领域；新领域必须单独评估，不能外推 81% 一致性。
  • 标签依赖 o3 与多数投票。人类一致性只衡量抽样对上的对齐，不是无误金标；应保留各次投票并审计分歧。
  • 论文未系统优化与其他偏好集的混合比例。投入生产前需核验数据可得性、许可、领域平衡和聊天能力的权衡。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For a long-document product team, collect paired outputs on its own tasks, define explicit hallucination and completeness criteria, and retain independent judge votes before training a pairwise reward model. Inputs are licensed documents, response pairs, a documented judge, and a human audit set; outputs are preference records, a held-out benchmark, and an RM/PPO comparison. Success is blind human or independent-judge preference on a frozen test set. Do not reuse labels unchanged for chat or creative writing; first add representative tasks and measure judge-human agreement.
面向长文档产品团队，可在自有任务上收集回答对，明确幻觉与完整性标准，保留独立裁判投票后再训练成对奖励模型。输入是有许可的文档、回答对、可追溯裁判和人工审计集；输出是偏好记录、留出基准和 RM/PPO 对照。成功标准是在冻结测试集上获得盲评人类或独立裁判偏好。不能原样用于聊天或创作；应先加入代表性任务并测裁判与人类一致性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position. OpenGenAlign targets preference modeling for long-context quality, especially hallucination and completeness.
  2. Method handle. Three o3 decisions over four dimensions are majority-voted for every response pair.
  3. Artifact handle. The paper reports 33K pairs, a 9K development set, and 1.5K held-out examples; the linked project is GitHub, while data release details need verification.
  4. Evidence anchor. A Llama-3.1-8B RM reaches 85.9% held-out accuracy; PPO with it has 87.7% average o3 win rate for the 8B policy.
  5. Reuse decision. Use for long QA/data-to-text/summarization after preserving votes; first test domain coverage and label agreement before mixing it with chat data.

1. 一句话定位。 OpenGenAlign 面向长上下文质量偏好，重点是幻觉与完整性。
  2. 方法抓手。 每个回答对由 o3 依四维做三次判决，再多数投票。
  3. 数据抓手。 论文报告 33K 对、9K 开发集、1.5K 留出例；项目链接为 GitHub，数据发布细节仍需核验。
  4. 证据锚点。 Llama-3.1-8B 奖励模型留出准确率为 85.9%；以它 PPO 的 8B 策略平均 o3 胜率为 87.7%。
  5. 复用决定。 适合长问答、数据到文本、摘要，且必须保存投票；混入聊天数据前先测领域覆盖与标签一致性。
